title: The role of parameter Jacobians in the stability of network outputs
summary: In the framework of network dynamics, learning models, and neural tangent kernels (NTK), we show that the corresponding linearized dynamics leads naturally to a semigroup formulation. More precisely, in our analysis of input/output models, the time-dynamics is presented via special semigroups of linear operators on Hilbert spaces, together with an associated class of semigroup perturbations.
